title: Nurturing a Free Palestine w/ Dr. Fauziah Hasan and Azra Banu
author: CounterPunch Radio
content:
This is part two of our series with Palestinian solidarity activists from
Malaysia. Dr. Fauziah Hasan and Azra Banu of the Asia Pacific Women’s
Coalition for Al Quds and Palestine discuss the importance of consisent,
coalitional efforts to support Palestinian women. Dr. Fauziah sailed on the
Women’s Boat to Gaza in 2016 and again on the 2025 Freedom Flotilla that was
abducted by Israel. Azra participated in a humanitarian land convoy in 2010
that drove from London to Gaza, and went on a second mission to Gaza in 2012.
As mothers and grandmothers, they emphasize the passing on of
intergenerational activist knowledge and the necessity of nurturing a
generation of young people committed to Palestinian Liberation in the Asia-
Pacific.
